steps.domain_action: Initialize the workspace for a single 1D manifold in a 2D plane
Identify the parent ring as a single closed loop with N vertices
Locate and remove two diametric edge pairs on the parent ring
Branch the parent into two distinct arc paths at the excision points
T-Branch: Apply AFWD to bridge the first arc into a smaller closed ring
F-Branch: Apply AREV to the second arc to clear any stray dangling vertices
Bridge the second arc into its own independent closed ring
Reconstitute the total system energy as a pair of daughter cycles
Verify that the sum of the daughter spectra equals the parent spectrum
Chain the verified daughter states into a stable dual-system configuration
Record the fission event as a permanent change in the graph database
Close the system boundary to prevent further unplanned topology shifts
